therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Proteasome inhibition, DNA alkylation, anti-inflammatory/immunosuppressive effects
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Multiple myeloma cell death through proteasome inhibition combined with DNA damage and immune modulation

results.dose_information: Ixazomib 4mg days 1,8,15 (cycle 1), then days 1,4,8,11,15,18 (cycles 2-6), then maintenance days 1,8,15 for 1.5 years; Cyclophosphamide 50mg daily continuous; Dexamethasone 20mg days 1,8,15 (cycle 1), then days 1,4,8,11,15,18 (cycles 2-6)
